snippet.title: Birushana: Winds of Fate | Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Switch™
snippet.description:
ESRB: RP

【Wishlist the Plus Edition】
https://IFI.STORE/products/birushana-winds-pe

【Wishlist the Standard Edition】
https://IFI.STORE/products/birushana-winds-se

【Official Website】
https://IFI.GAMES/birushanawof

See Shanao's story continue with the five love interests from the first Birushana, or return to the time of war and get to know four new potential partners. Wishlist the Plus Edition today at the IFI Online Store. Birushana: Winds of Fate is set to launch physically and digitally for the Nintendo Switch in 2026!

About Birushana: Winds of Fate
Fifteen years after the Heiji Rebellion, the Heike clan has reached the height of its power, while the Genji clan remains devastated by defeat.

Hidden deep within the mountains of Kurama lives Shanao, the youngest surviving male heir to the Genji name. However, Shanao harbors a deep secret known to very few...

The youngest heir to the Genji name is no man.

Epilogues
With the war over, peace has finally returned to the land.

After our heroine carved out a new fate,
these sweet epilogues tell the story of what happened after the events of the first game.

What does the future have in store for a girl who was born to fight?

Main Routes
New stories await our heroine...

The youngest child of the Genji, Shanao,
has been driven out of Kyoto by the Heike.

What fate awaits her as she strives to hide
her identity and live as a man in a world torn apart by war?

#birushana #otome
